release_slices.name: Regression Risk Notice evidence rendering
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Make the operator-facing Regression Risk Notice show readable evidence instead of JavaScript object-string output.
release_slices.purpose: Make the operator-facing Regression Risk Notice show readable evidence instead of JavaScript object-string output.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Adds a formatter for structured notice entries so command, status, evidence, name, and detail fields render in Markdown, and adds a regression test that blocks unreadable object-string output.
included_features: Readable operator evidence in regression risk notices
Fail-closed unit coverage for structured evidence rendering
excluded_features: GitHub Actions billing fallback authorization changes

completed_tests.evidence: local-validation-2026-06-30: 4 tests PASS including structured, nested, mixed-shape evidence rendering without unreadable object-string output
local-validation-2026-06-30: reviewed manifest covers the script, test, and release-batch manifest
local-validation-2026-06-30: Markdown notice renders command/status/evidence fields instead of object-string output
local-validation-2026-06-30: no compliance-sensitive runtime behavior changed

documentation_closure.rationale: This is a release-tooling Markdown rendering fix. The authoritative workflow already requires the Regression Risk Notice; this batch document records exact scope and evidence for the operator-facing formatter fix.

documents.evidence: Already requires machine-readable and operator-readable Regression Risk Notice artifacts before signed authorization.
Records exact reviewed file coverage, tests, rollback notes, and production proof expectations for this release-tooling fix.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: No ADR update is required because this only changes operator-facing release evidence formatting and does not change runtime boundaries, production trust roots, payment behavior, or database contracts.
release_slices.rollback_notes: Revert the formatter and test commit if the notice output is rejected. The rollback restores previous JSON behavior but may reintroduce unreadable Markdown object-string output.
production_proof_required: origin/master contains the formatter fix after governed promotion
Regression Risk Notice Markdown for the production candidate contains readable command/status/evidence text
Production deployment proof matches the exact promoted master SHA if later deployed
production_accuracy_checks_required: Generated regression_risk_notice.md does not contain unreadable object-string output
Structured completed-test evidence renders with command, status, and evidence text
Machine-readable regression_risk_notice.json remains valid and unchanged in schema intent
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: Regression Risk Notice evidence rendering may regress release evidence readability or operator review if structured evidence is formatted incorrectly.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: Operator review of release evidence before staging or production authorization

evidence_covering_regression_risk.evidence: Structured, nested, and mixed-shape evidence renders as readable text or deterministic JSON, not unreadable object-string output.
Generated notice for this slice passes with readable Markdown output.

evidence_gaps: This fix does not provision isolated QA or authorize production deployment.
rollback_or_monitoring_notes: Regenerate regression_risk_notice.md for each release candidate and scan for unreadable object-string output.
If notice rendering fails, revert this slice and treat operator Markdown evidence as blocked until fixed.
